messages:
Maria_Sales: FYI - Cabana Health procurement just asked for a POC evidence packet: SOC 2 summary, ISO27001 excerpt, pen-test attestation that explicitly covers the Dedicated POC, plus staging IPs and SAML metadata. They want it by EOD Thu. Anyone see immediate blockers?
Sam_Security: I can draft the pen-test attestation. Quick clarification - the POC is Dedicated single-tenant, right? Scope wording changes if it's hosted multitenant.
Maria_Sales: Confirmed Dedicated single-tenant pool. Also asked about KMS separation details and whether we can provide presigned upload flow for logs.
Raj_Engineer: For Dedicated we'll need to confirm egress model: will Cabana place an allowlist or expect static egress from our side? Ops recommends presigned S3 for uploads, less risky than sharing staging creds.
Elaine_Docs: I have the SOC2 executive summary and the ISO cert excerpt in the docs drive. I'll attach them to the ticket. Which format do they want for ISO - scanned cert or PDF excerpt?
Nina_Legal: We can provide a redacted PDF excerpt of the ISO certificate. For the pen-test letter, Legal must review prior to signing. Also need to confirm an NDA/PO is in place before we sign any attestation.
deploy-bot: Created ticket TCKT-8345 for Cabana POC evidence and pen-test coordination.
Maria_Sales: Cabana says NDA + PO are in their shared dropbox (link pasted in DM). I asked them to share drive access in the ticket.
Tom_Finance: On pricing: Cabana asked if we do a trial discount for Dedicated POCs. We can offer a one-time 20% discount on the first month for proof-of-concept customers under 90 days, pending RevOps sign-off. Note: any Dedicated onboarding or SRE retention for residency work is billable.
Raj_Engineer: Operational checklist I'd like to capture: 1) Provide staging IPs/CIDR for allowlist 2) Generate SAML IdP metadata for test SSO 3) Document KMS key separation and key lifecycle 4) Schedule a 2-hour oncall window during pen-test. Who takes runbook ownership?
Sam_Security: I'll own pen-test coordination and put a draft attestation in the ticket. Draft snippet below (placeholder dates):

"To whom it may concern,
Redwood Inference authorizes a scoped penetration test against the Dedicated POC environment maintained for Cabana Health. Testing shall be limited to application endpoints and infrastructure explicitly listed in the scope appendix. Attempts to access production data stores or customer data outside the scoped environment are prohibited. Redwood will provide an internal contact for coordination and will approve testing windows in advance. This attestation is subject to signing by Redwood Legal.
Signed: Redwood Legal (signature upon final review)"

Sam_Security: Legal signing confirmed? Nina_Legal: Legal will sign after we verify NDA/PO and review the final scope. We will not backdate letters. We can, however, include language allowing the parties to retroactively confirm an agreed testing window, but issuance date will be current.
Raj_Engineer: Another potential blocker: if Cabana later asks that POC be treated as production for SOC2 scope, that triggers an audit gap assessment and likely an SRE retainer. Flagging to sales.
Tom_Finance: Noted. I'll pre-approve the 20% POC discount for the quote; if they request residency or longer-term single-tenant, I'll escalate to RevOps for committed capacity pricing.
Elaine_Docs: Actioning: I'll upload soc2-exec-summary.pdf and iso-excerpt.pdf to TCKT-8345 now.
Sam_Security: I'll post the full pen-test attestation draft into the ticket for Legal to review.
Nina_Legal: Once docs are in the ticket and NDA/PO confirmed, Legal can complete review and sign within ~48 hours.
Maria_Sales: Plan: deliver initial evidence packet to Cabana by EOD Thu. Owners: Sam (pen-test + contact), Elaine (SOC2/ISO docs), Raj (staging IPs + runbook), Nina (legal signature), Tom (confirm discount in quote). Ping me if anything slips. :thumbsup:
Sam_Security: Will do. Updating TCKT-8345 now. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: TCKT-8345 updated: attachments soc2-exec-summary.pdf, iso-excerpt.pdf, pen-test-draft.docx
